Use case: style-transfer. This is the SINGLE FINAL REVISION of the first image, not another person. Images 2-5 are the four approved visual style cores: Mara, Iwo, Leiya and Tore. Redraw the FIRST portrait to correct the following visible problems, following the genuine coarse pixel language and FACE-FIRST framing of those four cores.
CRITICAL CHANGES: 
1. Replace BOTH big white eyes in image 1 with TINY DARK deep-set eyes. Dark brown pupils/irises and deep eye sockets dominate. No white sclera shapes at all; only at most a SINGLE muted medium-brown pixel at outer corner. Eyes should be subtle, barely lit, approx 4 logical pixels wide each. This is NOT a cartoon eye expression.
2. Make face larger relative to hair mass and COLLAPSE THE NECK: chin should sit directly above a narrow clothing edge. Only 2-3 logical pixel rows of exposed neck visible below the jaw. NO long neck triangles, NO exposed throat pillar, NO shoulders or chest. The forehead-to-chin face should dominate the portrait. Keep all hair tips and ear complete with actual transparent blank space: 3 logical pixels left and right, 3 above hair, 2 beneath the collar. Do not cut hair to enlarge the face.
3. COARSE 74x100 logical pixel construction: a few confident planar nose, cheekbone, jaw and forehead blocks. Remove diagonal stair noise and tiny individual hair/beard hatching. Each hairstyle is 5-8 major clumps, with only 2-3 tonal planes. Each beard is a few coherent flat areas. No fine dots or checkerboard stipple. Temporary palette <=32 colors, hard edges, no smoothing, gradients or anti-alias. This revision must look simpler and more intentionally pixel-blocked than image 1, not merely a filter on it.
Preserve identity, age, hair color and silhouette character, big asymmetrical nose, visible ear, mature face. Same three-quarter left-facing angle. Genuine transparent RGBA; one single head portrait only, no text, label, frame, props or second person.
Identity: Sefin, male fisherman in his mid-to-late forties. Preserve warm weathered sea-worn skin, dark brown tousled hair with broad gray-streak masses, short squared salt-and-pepper beard and mustache. Do not make him elderly. Temperament: heavy thoughtful mouth and guarded sideways glance, a stable mature brow with modest asymmetry; NO pleading high inner brows or melodramatic sorrow. Short beard, face planes and gray streak distinguish him from Tanser. At bottom only a TINY blue round neckline and brown collarless vest edges, no long bare neck. The old white eyes and striped hair in image 1 are precisely what must be redesigned.
